# Media requests triggers

## Media request skipped

Runs when a requested video is skipped. Good for a short message in chat.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The video's title |
| `%user%` | The viewer who requested it |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.mediaSkipped`</small>

## Media request started playing

Runs when a requested video starts playing. Good for announcing "now playing" in chat.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The video's title |
| `%user%` | The viewer who requested it |
| `%author%` | The channel that made the video |
| `%url%` | The video's web link |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.mediaStarted`</small>

## Media requested

Runs when a song or video request is added to the queue. Good for thanking the viewer who requested it.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The video's title |
| `%user%` | The viewer who requested it |
| `%author%` | The channel that made the video |
| `%url%` | The video's web link |
| `%position%` | Its place in the queue (0 = playing right now) |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.mediaRequested`</small>
